payload.verifiable:
All 29 requirements plus D1 carry a named verify_method, and naming it WAS the verifiability check - nothing was kept whose method could not be named. Twenty-five by test. Two by test plus inspection (R9 consultation logged by name, R27 secrets masked - both need a human to confirm the record reads as intended, not only that a field exists). One by inspection plus test (R18 lints compute facts, because 'this lint judges a fact rather than an intent' is a design property a test cannot fully carry). D1 by demonstration, and it is deliberately the only unautomatable one.

Nothing was rewritten or dropped for unverifiability, which is worth stating plainly rather than as an absence: the requirements came out of use-case steps and extensions, and steps that describe observable behaviour tend to name their own checks.

payload.functions_cover:
Every requirement requires at least one of the 28 functions, and every use-case step and extension maps - the full two-way mapping is recorded at derive_functions.

Two separations there are load-bearing rather than tidy: F22 (name the record immutably) apart from F23 (name it readably), because conflating them IS today's defect - a deletable label is currently the only pointer; and F18 (decide) apart from F19 (defer), because if they merge, 'cannot decide' silently becomes 'fail' and parks an unattended run.

TWO USE-CASE STEPS MAP TO NO FUNCTION, and both are correct boundaries rather than holes: UC-A step 2, deciding WHICH source to consult, is the agent's judgement and a system that chose would be doing something the excluded-use list forbids; and UC-B extension 3a, the lane being faster than a script, is a quality property rather than a function. Recorded because an unmapped step normally signals a missing function, and here it signals the boundary holding.
payload.set_holds:
COMPLETE against the use cases: every main-scenario step and every numbered extension of UC-A/B/C/D maps to at least one requirement; both killers carried.

CONSISTENT: one failure philosophy throughout - REFUSE RATHER THAN GUESS - applied at R2 (oversize), R8 (missing args), R10 (no match), R12 (atomic batch), R19 (failing lint names its fact), R29 (escaped root). The single apparent exception, R17's defer, is not a guess: it is an explicit handoff to judgement, and it exists precisely so that 'cannot decide' never becomes a silent refusal.

AFFORDABLE: one dependency, one new module (lints), one new tool (se_config), extensions to four existing modules - and DELETIONS, since the hand-rolled searcher goes. The surface does not only grow. Two probes shrank it further: git already searches refs and v1, so R5/R6 need no new engine.

BOUNDED: draw_context's twelve excluded-use lines bind; nothing here indexes product files, judges intent, parks a run, or pushes.

NO TBD.

HONEST LIMITS, both named rather than buried:
(1) R14's MECHANISM IS NOT SETTLED. The requirement - applicable rules reach the packet - stands and is right. But P5 proved the obvious mechanism does not exist: only ten ledger nodes carry applies_to, ZERO machine-state nodes do, and the field's content is human prose ('every guard, check and refusal in the engine and in any design'), not a selector. Choosing the mechanism is an M4 decision with three named candidates, one of which may need an M5 spike. I am blessing the requirement, not a mechanism.
(2) R16/R20 assume a gate can DECLARE which checks are lintable and that the M4 element allocation is machine-readable enough for the models-adhered lint. The second half is unknown and goes to M5 as a spike. If it fails, R16 survives with fewer lints and story S2's second slide changes.
payload.breaks_if_removed:
Filled on all 29 plus D1, each naming a concrete failure rather than a virtue. The ones that name a WITNESSED failure rather than a predicted one, which is what makes this register different from a wish list: R2 (a silently truncated file reads as a complete one), R8 (a wrong arg name made search return confident hits for the literal word 'undefined'), R11 (645 calls, 28 failures, one hand-rolled sweep script), R13 (a script rewrote six product files with no ledger trace), R14 (four laws minted today would never reach a packet), R21 (the state-of-the-art check exists in guidance, is collected nowhere, and has therefore never been performed), R23 (verified today - push.followTags carries only annotated tags and ours are lightweight), R24 (git itself warned 'refname is ambiguous' during P3), R26 (enabling the brief store needed a script, and the owner asked why the tools were not used), R28 (i8 already hit the unbounded-read failure in its transport).

Eleven of thirty name something that actually happened. The rest name failures the design would create.
payload.assumptions_probed:
FIVE PROBED against the real channel at probe_assumptions (run-6405dc1414a2, run-def39eabb75a). Two came back FALSE and were folded upstream BEFORE this gate rather than discovered during build.

FALSE: 'rg will be on the machine' - it is not on PATH on the owner's own primary machine, so the npm package is the delivery mechanism rather than a wrapper, and the no-fallback ruling now rests entirely on that package resolving. The RAID entry's trigger was resharpened accordingly.
FALSE, and consequential: 'applies_to is machine-readable enough to join guidance' - ten nodes carry it, zero machine states do, and its content is prose. R14's mechanism reopened as an M4 decision.
CONFIRMED DEFECT: the branch/tag name collision is real - git emitted 'warning: refname iter/i8d-phone-brief is ambiguous' during the probe and resolved silently to one of them. R24 is load-bearing by observation now, not by argument.
PASS: git grep searches a tag ref and returns parseable ref:path:count output.
PASS: v1 is reachable as branch main of this same repository - which removed declared roots from the critical path entirely.

SCHEDULED WITH REASON, not probed: whether the M4 element allocation is machine-readable enough for a models-adhered lint. It needs a prototype rather than a probe and goes to M5, where it was already named at gate_inputs as the one assumption story S2 rests on.
